Seems like there was a timezone mismatch between the event metadata and what our team expected.

Apologies if this was my side — would you be able to resend in Asia/Singapore time or suggest a couple of APAC-friendly slots? Our core team (me + Arjun) is available next week morning SGT (9:00–11:30) or late afternoon (16:00–18:00).

I'll send a corrected invite in SGT and include a few alternate slots. Marissa (cc'd) will join as well in case we need to cover different time blocks. Proposed slots (all Asia/Singapore time):

- Tue Jan 20, 10:30–11:00 SGT

- Wed Jan 21, 09:00–09:30 SGT

I've attached an updated deck and a corrected .ics (corrected-invite.ics) — please accept whichever slot works best and the invite will show in your calendar in the right local time. Also linking the HubSpot record and the demo playbook here for quick reference.

Again, apologies for the confusion — we'll make sure the reschedule is explicit with multiple timezone labels so this doesn't happen again.
